priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts still registers handler with socket.on("message", handler) and returns an empty disposer at line 3; the full diff shows this PR replaced socket.off("message", handler), so cleanup still retains the listener and repeated attach/dispose cycles duplicate callbacks and retain closures.
